title: Twenty-sided polynomial decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) and budget 5

claims.statement: The explicit two-component 2000-use polynomial-tag decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) and a per-group cost cap of 5 has uniform-message average block error at most 476481182634220819/500000000000000000 on BSC(1/10).
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes exactly W=74648449142 primitives on every input, with W<=2^(180597/5000).

experiments.purpose: Verify exact tag and leader spectra and the independent pair bounds by support. The final sector checks exact admitted volume, block error, memory and RAM cost.
